design: Retrospective public-data evaluation; no new prospective plant experiment
test_set_policy: Report every prespecified result. Do not select parameters using evaluation outcomes. Corrections to readers or metrics require a recorded deviation and rerun, not silent replacement.

gas_turbine.scope: Contemporaneous energy-yield estimation from ambient measurements at one power plant; not a causal plant model or human failure probability

steel_energy.scope: Rolling one-interval forecast with genuinely available earlier measurements; not a whole-quarter open-loop forecast. Same-interval reactive power, carbon quantity, power factors and load type are excluded.
steel_energy.clock_assumption: A 00:00 row following same-date 23:45 is assigned the next-day interval boundary only when source neighbors confirm the pattern. Preserve source_time_raw and record changed rows. This is a declared interpretation, not new measured timing.

continuous_distillation.label: Label (common/all)
continuous_distillation.reference: Source-named normal files at exactly the same scenario and operating point; no transfer to a different operating point
continuous_distillation.score: Maximum absolute robust standardized deviation; scale=max(1.4826*MAD, explicit unit-specific floor)
continuous_distillation.event_matching: One alarm activation per contiguous positive-label event; activation must lie inside the event. No point adjustment. Missing sensor values break alarm timers.
continuous_distillation.scope: Retrospective run-disjoint monitoring replay; some reference runs occur after evaluated runs. Experimental anomaly enrichment is not natural incidence or HEP. Missing matched reference withholds evaluation.

water_thermodynamic_consistency.population: All source-named normal Scenario A runs, without selecting on prediction residuals
water_thermodynamic_consistency.prediction: CoolProp HEOS Water saturation temperature at PIC101*100 Pa, Q=0
water_thermodynamic_consistency.scope: Unfitted property consistency check. Head pressure approximates the temperature measurement's local pressure; pressure gradients, heat losses and sensor uncertainty are not fully characterized. This is not complete simulator validation.

rail_incidents.outcome: Presence of each C1-C8 investigation code among recorded accidents
rail_incidents.denominator: recorded accidents, never successful task opportunities
rail_incidents.analysis: Descriptive counts, overlaps, missingness and explicit incompatibility with failure-on-demand estimation
rail_incidents.scope: Reported field incidents and investigator coding; not prospective behavior, a causal intervention effect or plant HEP calibration

sacada_context_validation.split: Per-function sorted context IDs shuffled once with the frozen seed; last ceil(0.3*n) contexts held out
models: training pooled probability with explicit Beta(0.5,0.5) prior
C=1 logistic regression on all numeric released context fields using aggregate success/failure weights
sacada_context_validation.scope: Held-out aggregate context prediction in the existing simulator population. Crew identities and overlap are unavailable; no independent-crew, field-transfer or causal claim.

regression_evaluation.interval: Symmetric absolute-residual split-calibration interval at nominal 90%; use the finite-calibration order statistic
regression_evaluation.coverage_claim: Descriptive held-out coverage only: serial dependence and drift prevent an exchangeability guarantee
regression_evaluation.bootstrap: 1000 paired contiguous-block resamples; 24 rows for turbine hourly samples and 96 rows for steel quarter-hour samples. Report descriptive RMSE-difference interval, not an IID confidence claim.

clock_policy: Preserve original timestamps. Parse mixed date/time formats and unwrap only unambiguous midnight changes. Duplicates, ambiguous backwards motion or large gaps withhold physical-time delay metrics. Sample-index delays remain available. Do not silently create dates, resample or interpolate measurements.
publication: Original code, metadata, checksums, source conditions, rights, aggregate metrics and retained limitations. Raw archives, participant rows, source publications and third-party notebooks stay outside Git and distributions.
amendment: Clock interpretation only, before steel model fitting; no change to predictors, split boundaries, estimator parameters or metrics.
